name: Product Launch & Brand Activation

heroImage.alt: Branded Sip Social coffee cart at a product launch

intro: Turn the cart into a fully branded activation — your logo, your cups, a standout moment guests will photograph.
body: A branded coffee cart does two things a normal catering stand can't: it gives people a reason to come to you, and it hands them something with your branding on it that they'll carry around the room, photograph, and post. For a launch or activation, that's worth more than the coffee itself.

We apply your logo to the cart and print custom takeaway cups, so the whole set-up reads as part of your event rather than a generic add-on. It works as a standalone activation or alongside a wider launch.
highlights: Your logo on the cart, your branding on every cup
A natural gathering point for guests at a launch
Genuinely photographable — built for social sharing
Flexible on timing, from a two-hour activation to a full day

faqs.q: How far ahead do you need our branding?
faqs.a: The earlier the better once you've booked — cup printing has its own lead time, so send logo files as soon as you have them.

faqs.q: Can the cart match our brand colours?
faqs.a: Within what's practical on the day — let us know your palette when you enquire and we'll talk through what's possible.
